known.via: English Wikipedia "Tursan" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Sauvignon Blanc, Riesling, Chardonnay, Sémillon and Cabernet Franc fully without cooking off their freshness.
Sauvignon Blanc sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

soil.rock: Clay holds water well but drains poorly. It stays cool, which slows ripening and keeps acidity up. Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water. Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.
